title: Connect a past start to the present
instructions: Choose the form supported by the complete time period.

parts.prompt: Since the recycling project began in January, the club ___ 240 bottles, and the collection is continuing.

choice_rationales.A: Simple past would place the collection in a finished past period, but the sentence says it is continuing.
choice_rationales.B: Simple present can describe a routine but does not express the accumulated result since January.
choice_rationales.C: Past continuous views an action around a past point and does not connect the total to now.
choice_rationales.D: Has collected links the January start to the present accumulated total.

parts.hint: The period begins in the past and explicitly continues to the present.
parts.correct_explanation: Since January and the continuing collection create a past-to-present period, so present perfect fits the accumulated result.
